report.summary: The report is well sourced: every [^drhp-pNN] tag was located and, after independently re-computing each embedded figure (revenue, EBITDA, net profit, total assets, long- and short-term borrowings, order-book and revenue percentages), all numbers, years, names and percentages reconcile to the cited pages' excerpts. The only soft spots are stylistic attributions — 'the filing describes... a sharp increase' (p27 carries only the figures) and 'performance could suffer' (p12 frames it as revenue/financial condition) — but no invented specific was found, and every checkable sentence carries a citation, so there are no untagged claims. No blocking issues.
